name: Malacca blocked
question: If the Strait of Malacca is blocked for a month, what happens to us?
answer:
A 30-day Malacca block would stop 23 products. The first to stop is BMS-48V-16S (Kairo EV) on day 14, when PRT-018 runs out. The assumptions are a full 30-day stop and stock as of 30 Sep 2026.

- ₹54.08 cr revenue is at risk. That is ₹29.74 cr in lost sales and ₹5.84 cr in margin.
- All 6 customers fall below 95% OTIF. Pratham Auto is worst, dropping to 0% in the week of 19 Oct. Kairo EV falls to 30% and Ojas Motors to 15% in the same week.
- Top option: transship PRT-018 via Colombo. It costs ₹59,812, takes effect in 1 day and has a net value of ₹2.52 cr. The approver is the Category manager.
- Second option: air-freight expedite for PRT-018. It costs ₹12.0 lakh, takes 4 days and has a net value of ₹2.26 cr. The approver is also the Category manager.

name: Compare two places
question: Compare our exposure to Kaohsiung and Shanghai.
answer:

- Kaohsiung: 5 parts, 4 of them single-source, feeding 15 products. The tightest cover is PRT-048 at 11 days against a 45-day lead time. The main revenue dependence is PRT-002 at ₹729.9 cr/yr. Fallbacks for PRT-002, PRT-007 and PRT-049 are unqualified, and PRT-048 has none.
- Shanghai: 6 parts, 4 of them single-source, feeding 16 products. The tightest cover is PRT-044 at 9 days against 30. PRT-017 has the largest revenue dependence at ₹857.2 cr/yr. It has no fallback, and neither do PRT-010 or PRT-043.
